comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is most similar (42.8%) to insect Stomoxyn. Mol Formula: C268H443N73O83S2; Mol Wt: 6119.047; GRAVY: 0.949; Activity: Antibacterial activity was tested using the recombinant fusion protein with thioredoxin Trx-stomoxynZH1. Active against E. coli (MIC 15-30 ug/ml) and S. aureus (MIC 27-54 ug/ml). There are additional peptides reported without activity data yet.
title: Screening, Expression, Purification and Functional Characterization of Novel Antimicrobial Peptide Genes From Hermetia Illucens (L.)
